linear_attention.peak_basis: One p300c Blackhole ASIC:120 physical cores,1.35GHz,4096 FLOP/cycle/core LoFi theoretical peak;512GB/s GDDR6. Runtime storage grid110 cores; matmul reader workers16. No multi-device aggregation.
linear_attention.traffic_assumptions: Estimated compulsory physical traffic: BFP4 weights including exponent headers and reader padding read once; BF16 residual input/output; FP32 recurrent and row-major BF16 convolution state read/write, or BFP8 prefix KV read plus token write. Excludes intermediate spills, repeated reads and small constants: lower bound, not bus counters.
linear_attention.flops_assumptions: Useful dense matmul work and logical causal attention/recurrence/scalar work; no MoE and no padding counted useful. Mixed BF16 activations, BFP4/LoFi projections, FP32/HiFi4 sensitive recurrence/attention: denominator is chip LoFi peak, not an achievable mixed-kernel ceiling.
linear_attention.source: single-layer Tracy; complete firmware timestamp envelope including all operations and internal gaps
